publishedRecipe.name: Linguini with Tofu, Fresh Tomato Sauce, Zucchini, Basil & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 pints grape tomatoes
4 medium zucchini squash
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 lemon

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu to the skillet and sprinkle with spices; cook, turning often, until golden on all sides, about 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
When the tofu is done, remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat and add more oil, swirling to coat the bottom. Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 15 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, zucchini, broth, Italian seasoning, and salt to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until zucchini is soft and sauce has thickened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Cut lemon into wedges; set both aside.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add zucchini-tomato sauce and tofu to the pot; gently toss to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates; top with Parmesan, basil, and a squeeze of lemon. Enjoy!
